mapper.select: SELECT * FROM question WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question ( questionnaire_id, content, type, options, score_mode, max_score, sort_order, deleted ) VALUES ( #{questionnaireId}, #{content}, #{type}, #{options}, #{scoreMode}, #{maxScore}, #{sortOrder}, 0 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE question
questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId},
content = #{content},
type = #{type},
options = #{options},
score_mode = #{scoreMode},
max_score = #{maxScore},
sort_order = #{sortOrder},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE question SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
